changes.name: ConnectedIslandExpansionV39
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService=game:GetService("TweenService")
local world=workspace:WaitForChild("GrowIslandWorld")

local folder=world:FindFirstChild("DirectionalExpansions") or Instance.new("Folder")
folder.Name="DirectionalExpansions";folder.Parent=world
folder:ClearAllChildren()

-- Each level grows only NORTH, EAST, and SOUTH.
-- There is intentionally NO west/left land at all, keeping the sign side open to the void.
local layers={}
local STEP=14
local START=27

local function add(layer,name,size,pos)
 local p=Instance.new("Part")
 p.Name=name;p.Size=size;p.Position=pos-Vector3.new(0,10,0)
 p.Anchored=true;p.CanCollide=false;p.Transparency=1
 p.Material=Enum.Material.Grass;p.Color=Color3.fromRGB(102,190,105)
 p.Parent=folder
 table.insert(layers[layer],{part=p,target=pos})
end

for layer=1,9 do
 layers[layer]={}
 local inner=START+(layer-1)*STEP
 local outer=START+layer*STEP
 local center=(inner+outer)/2

 -- North and south begin at the starter island's WEST edge (X=-27),
 -- never extending farther left behind the upgrade signs.
 local eastEdge=outer
 local width=eastEdge+27
 local xCenter=(-27+eastEdge)/2

 add(layer,"L"..layer.."_North",Vector3.new(width,3,STEP),Vector3.new(xCenter,18.5,-center))
 add(layer,"L"..layer.."_South",Vector3.new(width,3,STEP),Vector3.new(xCenter,18.5,center))
 add(layer,"L"..layer.."_East",Vector3.new(STEP,3,inner*2),Vector3.new(center,18.5,0))
end

local shown={}
local function reveal(n)
 if shown[n] or not layers[n] then return end
 shown[n]=true
 for i,info in ipairs(layers[n]) do
  task.delay((i-1)*.06,function()
   local p=info.part
   if not p.Parent then return end
   p.Transparency=0;p.CanCollide=true
   TweenService:Create(p,TweenInfo.new(.65,Enum.EasingStyle.Back,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{Position=info.target}):Play()
  end)
 end
end

local function hook(player)
 local stage=player:WaitForChild("IslandStage")
 for i=1,math.min(stage.Value,9) do reveal(i) end
 stage:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
  for i=1,math.min(stage.Value,9) do reveal(i) end
 end)
end
for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do task.spawn(hook,p) end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(hook)

print("Three-sided connected expansion loaded; sign side remains open")
